name: MuchoClient
description: One MuchoCore client for Daily Quests, clans, profiles, colors and server plugins

ui-animations.name: Smooth UI Animations
ui-animations.description: Animate Mucho windows, buttons, lists, progress and rewards. Extra effects are suspended during gameplay.

reduced-motion.name: Reduced Motion
reduced-motion.description: Keep gentle fades and progress transitions; disable window zoom, movement, animated counters and reward particles.

emoji-support.name: Emoji Support
emoji-support.description: Display bundled color emoji in bitmap text, plain comments/descriptions and Mucho UI. Restart after toggling for all existing paragraphs.
